subject: Student Social-Emotional Health and Inclusive Play
overview: The subcommittee reviewed strategies for trauma-informed care and student re-engagement during the return to in-person learning and discussed initiatives to foster inclusive social environments for students with disabilities.

items.title: Trauma-Informed School Re-entry
items.summary: The administration reported on expanded group counseling for anxiety and grief and announced the April launch of the 'Sandy Hook Promise' social-connection campaign.

items.title: Social-Emotional Health and Academic Recoupment
items.summary: Members debated the priority of emotional well-being over standardized testing and reported on the implementation of 'Zones of Regulation' and 'Responsive Classroom' protocols to manage student anxiety.

items.title: Disability Awareness and Social Story Resources
items.summary: Staff presented a new centralized website featuring inclusive lesson plans, social stories for navigating COVID-19 protocols, and universal design for learning resources.

items.title: Common Ground Program Expansion
items.summary: The subcommittee reviewed progress on transitioning the 'Common Ground' reverse-inclusion program into a formal high school elective and piloting it in middle schools.

items.title: Inclusive Recreation and McGlynn Playground Project
items.summary: Officials outlined the transition toward inclusive recreation models and provided an update on the RFP process for a universally accessible playground at the McGlynn School.
